desc: Paper Mario 64 partners on the Start menu's Party tab: Goombella out, Goombario and Kooper met. The tab shows Goombella with "{Y} Goombario" under the Swap Partners line (with room between them); Y puts Goombario in her place: his sprite, his name, his own description from the ROM, "{Y} Goombella"; X: his moves with PM64's names, FP and descriptions; Y again Goombella herself (her own text); Koops, Y: Kooper likewise. Shots: the tab, Goombario, his description scrolled (two), his moves (two), Goombella, Kooper, his moves, the field after
log_must: \[pm64\] Party tab: the partner in 1's place
